 function fmtMsShort(ms){
   return (ms/1000).toFixed(3)+'s';
 }
+
+function kalScheduleAutoLap(){
+  if(KAL.autoLapTimer){
+    clearTimeout(KAL.autoLapTimer);
+    KAL.autoLapTimer=null;
+  }
+  if(!KAL.autoLapEnabled || !KAL.swRunning) return;
+  const sec=Math.max(1,Math.min(600,Number(document.getElementById('kal-auto-lap-sec').value)||33));
+  KAL.autoLapTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
+    if(KAL.swRunning) kalSwLap();
+  },sec*1000);
+}
+
+window.kalToggleAutoLap=function(){
+  KAL.autoLapEnabled=!KAL.autoLapEnabled;
+  const btn=document.getElementById('kal-auto-lap-btn');
+  btn.textContent='AUTO LAP: '+(KAL.autoLapEnabled?'ON':'OFF');
+  kalScheduleAutoLap();
+};
+
+window.kalSeqSetCount=function(n){
+  KAL.seqCount=n;
+  [1,3,5,10,20,50].forEach(v=>{
+    const b=document.getElementById('kal-seq-c'+v);
+    if(b) b.classList.toggle('active',v===n);
+  });
+  const runBtn=document.getElementById('kal-seq-run');
+  if(runBtn) runBtn.textContent='▶ Uruchom '+n+'×';
+  kalSeqUpdateTotal();
+};
+
+function kalSeqUpdateTotal(){
+  const halfSec=Math.max(1,Number(document.getElementById('kal-seq-half-sec').value)||33);
+  const total=halfSec*KAL.seqCount;
+  const m=Math.floor(total/60);
+  const s=Math.round(total%60);
+  document.getElementById('kal-seq-total').textContent=total.toFixed(1)+'s = '+m+'m '+String(s).padStart(2,'0')+'s';
+}
+
+function kalSeqTick(){
+  if(!KAL.seqRunning) return;
+  const elapsed=Date.now()-KAL.seqStartTs;
+  const remaining=Math.max(0,KAL.seqDurationMs-elapsed);
+  const halfSec=Math.max(1,Number(document.getElementById('kal-seq-half-sec').value)||33);
+  const halfMs=halfSec*1000;
+  const currentHalf=Math.min(KAL.seqCount,Math.floor(elapsed/halfMs)+1);
+  const progress=document.getElementById('kal-seq-progress');
+  progress.textContent='▶ półcykl '+currentHalf+'/'+KAL.seqCount+' · pozostało '+Math.ceil(remaining/1000)+'s';
+  if(remaining<=0){
+    kalSeqStop(false,true);
+  }
+}
+
+window.kalSeqRun=function(){
+  if(KAL.seqRunning) return;
+  const halfSec=Math.max(1,Number(document.getElementById('kal-seq-half-sec').value)||33);
+  const durationMs=Math.round(halfSec*KAL.seqCount*1000);
+  const tray=parseInt(document.getElementById('kal-tray-sel').value);
+  const pwm=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round((KAL.pwm/100)*255)));
+  const progress=document.getElementById('kal-seq-progress');
+  KAL.seqRunning=true;
+  KAL.seqDurationMs=durationMs;
+  KAL.seqStartTs=Date.now();
+  document.getElementById('kal-seq-run').disabled=true;
+  document.getElementById('kal-seq-stop').disabled=false;
+  progress.textContent='Wysyłam komendę...';
+  fetch('/api/tray/move?tray='+tray+'&duration_ms='+durationMs+'&pwm_speed='+pwm,{method:'POST'})
+    .then(r=>r.json())
+    .then(d=>{
+      if(d&&d.ok){
+        progress.textContent='▶ uruchomiono';
+      }else{
+        progress.textContent='⚠ API: '+((d&&d.error)?d.error:'błąd');
+      }
+      if(KAL.seqTimer){clearInterval(KAL.seqTimer);} 
+      KAL.seqTimer=setInterval(kalSeqTick,500);
+    })
+    .catch(()=>{
+      progress.textContent='⚠ offline — odliczanie lokalne';
+      if(KAL.seqTimer){clearInterval(KAL.seqTimer);} 
+      KAL.seqTimer=setInterval(kalSeqTick,500);
+    });
+};
+
+window.kalSeqStop=function(manual,finished){
+  if(!KAL.seqRunning && !finished) return;
+  KAL.seqRunning=false;
+  if(KAL.seqTimer){
+    clearInterval(KAL.seqTimer);
+    KAL.seqTimer=null;
+  }
+  document.getElementById('kal-seq-run').disabled=false;
+  document.getElementById('kal-seq-stop').disabled=true;
+  const progress=document.getElementById('kal-seq-progress');
+  if(finished){
+    progress.textContent='✓ zakończono '+KAL.seqCount+'× półcykli';
+    return;
+  }
+  progress.textContent='■ zatrzymano';
+  if(manual){
+    const tray=parseInt(document.getElementById('kal-tray-sel').value);
+    fetch('/api/tray/stop?tray='+tray,{method:'POST'}).catch(()=>{});
+  }
+};
